findings.source: Девушка, у вас точно всё хорошо?
findings.currentTarget: Domnișoară, ești sigură că totul e în regulă?
findings.reason: The player addresses the woman with polite «у вас» in Russian; Romanian «ești» switches to informal singular. This changes the deliberate respectful address in the tense couple exchange, where the husband also uses polite forms toward the homeowner.
